# Apartment finishes

CC0 (public domain) textures from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com), 1K JPGs: colour (`diff`), OpenGL normal (`nor_gl`) and roughness (`rough`).

| Folder | Used for | Real size | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `laminate_floor_02` | living rooms, bedrooms, halls, kitchens | 1.7 m | https://polyhaven.com/a/laminate_floor_02 (Dario Barresi, Charlotte Baglioni) |
| `floor_tiles_06` | bathrooms | 3.0 m | https://polyhaven.com/a/floor_tiles_06 (Rob Tuytel) |
| `marble_01` | counters, vanity tops | 1.5 m | https://polyhaven.com/a/marble_01 (Rob Tuytel) |
| `white_plaster_02` | walls | 1.0 m | https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_02 (Rob Tuytel) |
| `white_oak_veneer` | cabinets, wardrobes, bed frames | 0.5 m | https://polyhaven.com/a/white_oak_veneer (Jenelle van Heerden) |
